## Dispatch order · `domain:ui#5` · `session_01JQwxbXGpVJHZTXXerMoY4C` · 2026-10-28T06:46Z

You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#27116, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone: read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` and `ui/AGENTS.md` before your first edit, and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself through REST (`curl -sS "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/27116" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`, every page); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; its `Branch:` line names your thread's branch. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Take another ui lane seat" one message with your branch name and wait. Worktree `objectstack-issue-27116` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=27116 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{WAS:…}}` / the now-token). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, line 3 `Fixes #27116`, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`; `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is a gate on every ui card. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes (`@object-ui/i18n` patch for namespace rows; app-shell is `private: true`). ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Take another ui lane seat" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

This card is a queue-flake anchor on the test file seat 5's #26892 (PR #27060) added. Your thread built that suite; your branch's PR is merged, so restart the branch from a fresh `origin/main` (`git fetch origin main && git checkout -B <branch> origin/main`) and open a NEW PR with `Fixes #27116`.

### Measured (seat, on `origin/main` `6817bf1e`)

- Victims: PR #27083 (root) and #27011 (inherited) in the queue, and PR #26999's own CI (Test UI 10/16 on `5aa7e972`), per ui seat 1.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/AppReportIndex.navGates-26892.test.tsx` ≈L356–359, "(f) CONTROL: offers it, once, to a member granted that permission": `await waitFor(() => expect(paletteReports()).toContain('Gamma'))`, then a synchronous `expect(paletteReports()).toEqual(ALL)`. Gamma arrives through the palette's nav door before the app-report list answers, so on a loaded shard Delta is still missing (received `['Alpha','Beta','Gamma']`).
- Fix: wait on the full answer, `await waitFor(() => expect(paletteReports()).toEqual(ALL))`. Then audit every case in the file for the same shape: a positive `toEqual` / `toContain` asserted synchronously after a wait that settles on a different element. `paletteSettled()` (≈L215) waits for Delta only: check each caller's following assertion holds once Delta is there, or wait on that assertion itself. Negative assertions after a settle stay as they are.

### Scope

File surface: that one test file. ⛔ No source change, no skip, no retry, no timeout bump. Proof: reproduce the race (e.g. delay the report/dataset list answer in the double, or run the file under `--sequence.shuffle` / heavy load) so the old CONTROL goes red and the fixed one stays green; report both. Gates as usual (`dispatch-gates`), `skip-changeset` (test-only, private package).

### Tier

No path-derived mandate. `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `low` (XS). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Scope addition (maintainer-directed): a two-line test-authoring rule, as a second PR · 2026-10-28T07:29Z

⛔ Not a claim. For the claiming seat (`domain:ui#5`, `os-warren`).

- Maintainer, verbatim: 「同意，搭在 #27116 上做」. It answers triage's proposal that the "write deterministic tests" rule ride this card, because the seat fixing this flake knows its shape best.
- **Why:** two of tonight's five main reds came from a test that picked its data with no filter and no order, then asserted on that row's state: #26952 (`?$top=1` on seeded tasks) and this card. Now that `Test UI` is required on `main` (maintainer, 2026-10-28), a flaky UI test ejects good PRs from the queue instead of reddening main. That is cheaper, but it is still a cost.
- **The rule (two lines, no gate):**
  1. In `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, the test-writing guidance: *a test never picks its data unordered. Every pick names a filter and a stable order, or creates the row it acts on, and asserts its precondition before it acts.*
  2. In `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md`, the seat's ACCEPT read: *the PR's new or changed tests pick no unordered data and wait on what they assert (not on a sibling element).*
- **⛔ Order: keep the p0 fix minimal.** PR #27128 stays the stop-bleed. The two lines land as a **second PR from this card's thread, after #27128 merges**. They are `.claude/**` (Tier S), and mixing them into the p0 PR would put a governed path into it and slow it. If the lines carry the measured shape of this flake (what #27128 found), that is the best wording.
- ⛔ The rule is prose only. No new check (the maintainer: 「新增门禁默认否」).
